ride_requests_decision_time.name: ride_requests_decision_time
ride_requests_decision_time.value: "ride_requests"."status" not in ('accepted','rejected') or "ride_requests"."decided_at" is not null

trips_status_reason.name: trips_status_reason
trips_status_reason.value: ("trips"."status"='active' and "trips"."cancellation_reason" is null) or ("trips"."status"='cancelled' and "trips"."cancellation_reason" is not null and length(trim("trips"."cancellation_reason"))>0)
